description.value: Osborne Bay Resort is an oceanfront camping and cottage resort perched along the shores of Crofton, BC, offering full-service RV sites, log cottages with fully-equipped kitchens, a rentable 40-foot oceanfront RV, and beachside camping. Open year-round, it sits close to the Crofton ferry terminal—a convenient jumping-off point for Salt Spring Island—and within easy pedalling distance of the Cowichan Valley trail network and the Chemainus murals town. The resort's laundromat, free hot showers, and diverse lodging formats make it a practical multi-night base for touring cyclists exploring southern Vancouver Island.
